import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ProjectiveTwistGeneration
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GrassmannianQuot

/-!
# Nonvanishing of the projective coordinate sections

The normalized coordinate `X_i / X_j` on the `j`-th projective chart is
invertible precisely on its intersection with the `i`-th chart.
-/

open CategoryTheory Limits MvPolynomial HomogeneousLocalization

noncomputable section

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwist

variable (n : Type)

private lemma unit_hom_ext_top {X : Scheme.{0}} {M : X.Modules}
    (s t : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ M)
    (h : s.val.app (.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) =
      t.val.app (.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) : s = t := by
  apply M.unitHomEquiv.injective
  refine PresheafOfModules.sections_ext _ _ fun U => ?_
  have hs := (M.unitHomEquiv s).property (homOfLE (show U.unop ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
  have ht := (M.unitHomEquiv t).property (homOfLE (show U.unop ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
  change M.val.presheaf.map _ (s.val.app (.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) =
    s.val.app U (1 : Γ(X, U.unop)) at hs
  change M.val.presheaf.map _ (t.val.app (.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) =
    t.val.app U (1 : Γ(X, U.unop)) at ht
  exact hs.symm.trans ((congrArg (M.val.presheaf.map _) h).trans ht)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- On any chart, a coordinate morphism is multiplication by its normalized coordinate. -/
lemma coordinateHomGlued_glueProj_eq_scalar (i j : n) :
    coordinateHomGlued n i ≫ Scheme.Modules.glueProj (glueData n)
      (fun j => SheafOfModules.unit ((glueData n).U j).ringCatSheaf)
      (fun j k => twistTransition n 1 j k)
      (fun j => twistTransition_self n 1 j)
      (fun j k l => twistTransition_cocycle n 1 j k l) j =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit ((glueData n).ι j).toRingCatSheafHom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ((glueData n).ι j)).map
          (Grassmannian.scalarEnd
            ((chartSectionsIso n j).hom (formChart 1 j ⟨X i, X_mem_deg_one n i⟩))) := by
  apply unit_hom_ext_top
  change (Scheme.Modules.glueProj (glueData n)
      (fun j => SheafOfModules.unit ((glueData n).U j).ringCatSheaf)
      (fun j k => twistTransition n 1 j k)
      (fun j => twistTransition_self n 1 j)
      (fun j k l => twistTransition_cocycle n 1 j k l) j).app ⊤
        ((Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection (serreTwistGlued n 1)
          (coordSectionGlued i)).app ⊤ (1 : Γ((glueData n).glued, ⊤))) = _
  rw [Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection_app_top_one, glueProj_coordSectionGlued]
  change _ = (Grassmannian.scalarEnd (X := (glueData n).U j) _).val.app (.op ⊤)
    ((((glueData n).ι j).toRingCatSheafHom.hom.app (.op ⊤)) (1 : Γ((glueData n).glued, ⊤)))
  rw [map_one, Grassmannian.scalarEnd_val_app_one]
  change _ = ((glueData n).U j).ringCatSheaf.obj.map (𝟙 (.op ⊤)) _
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

/-- The normalized coordinate is the localization element for intersecting two charts. -/
lemma formChart_coord_eq_isLocalizationElem (i j : n) :
    formChart 1 j ⟨X i, X_mem_deg_one n i⟩ =
      Away.isLocalizationElem (X_mem_deg_one n j) (X_mem_deg_one n i) := by
  simp only [formChart, Away.isLocalizationElem, pow_one]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The nonvanishing locus of `X_i/X_j` is the part of the `i`-th chart inside the `j`-th. -/
lemma basicOpen_formChart_coord (i j : n) :
    ((glueData n).U j).basicOpen
        ((chartSectionsIso n j).hom (formChart 1 j ⟨X i, X_mem_deg_one n i⟩)) =
      (basicOpenCover n).f j ⁻¹ᵁ
        Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{0} ℤ)) (X i) := by
  let e := Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{0} ℤ)) (X j)
    (X_mem_deg_one n j) one_pos
  let a := formChart 1 j ⟨X i, X_mem_deg_one n i⟩
  have hc : (basicOpenCover n).f j =
      e.hom ≫ Proj.awayι (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{0} ℤ)) (X j)
        (X_mem_deg_one n j) one_pos := by
    simp [e, Proj.awayι, basicOpenCover]
  rw [hc, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen
    (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{0} ℤ)) (X_mem_deg_one n j) one_pos
    (X_mem_deg_one n i) one_pos, ← formChart_coord_eq_isLocalizationElem]
  rw [← basicOpen_eq_of_affine (R := CommRingCat.of
    (Away (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{0} ℤ)) (X j))) a, Scheme.preimage_basicOpen]
  congr 1
  change (chartSectionsIso n j).hom a =
    (Proj.basicOpenToSpec (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{0} ℤ)) (X j)).app ⊤
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv a)
  rw [Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top]
  simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private lemma coordinateHomGlued_pullback_chart (i j : n) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((glueData n).ι j)).map (coordinateHomGlued n i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.glueRestrictionIso (glueData n)
        (fun j => SheafOfModules.unit ((glueData n).U j).ringCatSheaf)
        (fun j k => twistTransition n 1 j k)
        (fun j => twistTransition_self n 1 j)
        (fun j k l => twistTransition_cocycle n 1 j k l) j).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitIso ((glueData n).ι j)).hom ≫
        Grassmannian.scalarEnd
          ((chartSectionsIso n j).hom (formChart 1 j ⟨X i, X_mem_deg_one n i⟩)) := by
  change (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((glueData n).ι j)).map (coordinateHomGlued n i) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ((glueData n).ι j)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        (Scheme.Modules.glueProj (glueData n)
          (fun j => SheafOfModules.unit ((glueData n).U j).ringCatSheaf)
          (fun j k => twistTransition n 1 j k)
          (fun j => twistTransition_self n 1 j)
          (fun j k l => twistTransition_cocycle n 1 j k l) j) = _
  rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, coordinateHomGlued_glueProj_eq_scalar,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm]
  rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private lemma isUnit_of_isIso_scalarEnd {X : Scheme.{0}} (a : Γ(X, ⊤))
    [IsIso (Grassmannian.scalarEnd a)] : IsUnit a := by
  have h : Grassmannian.scalarEnd
      (Grassmannian.unitEndSection (inv (Grassmannian.scalarEnd a)) * a) =
        Grassmannian.scalarEnd (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) := by
    rw [← Grassmannian.scalarEnd_comp, Grassmannian.scalarEnd_unitEndSection,
      IsIso.inv_hom_id, Grassmannian.scalarEnd_one]
  have hm := congrArg Grassmannian.unitEndSection h
  simp only [Grassmannian.unitEndSection_scalarEnd] at hm
  exact ⟨⟨a, Grassmannian.unitEndSection (inv (Grassmannian.scalarEnd a)),
    (mul_comm _ _).trans hm, hm⟩, rfl⟩

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private lemma isUnit_appTop_coord_of_isIso_pullback {T : Scheme.{0}}
    (i j : n) (g : T ⟶ (glueData n).U j)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ (glueData n).ι j)).map
      (coordinateHomGlued n i))] :
    IsUnit (g.appTop ((chartSectionsIso n j).hom
      (formChart 1 j ⟨X i, X_mem_deg_one n i⟩))) := by
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ((glueData n).ι j)).map (coordinateHomGlued n i))) :=
    (NatIso.isIso_map_iff (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g ((glueData n).ι j))
      (coordinateHomGlued n i)).mpr inferInstance
  let e := Scheme.Modules.glueRestrictionIso (glueData n)
    (fun j => SheafOfModules.unit ((glueData n).U j).ringCatSheaf)
    (fun j k => twistTransition n 1 j k)
    (fun j => twistTransition_self n 1 j)
    (fun j k l => twistTransition_cocycle n 1 j k l) j
  let a := (chartSectionsIso n j).hom (formChart 1 j ⟨X i, X_mem_deg_one n i⟩)
  have h := congrArg ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map)
    (coordinateHomGlued_pullback_chart n i j)
  simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp] at h
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitIso ((glueData n).ι j)).hom) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (Grassmannian.scalarEnd a)) := by
    rw [← h]
    change IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ((glueData n).ι j)).map (coordinateHomGlued n i)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map e.hom)
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (Grassmannian.scalarEnd a)) :=
    (isIso_comp_left_iff ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitIso ((glueData n).ι j)).hom) _).mp inferInstance
  have hscalar := Grassmannian.scalarEnd_pullback g a
  haveI : IsIso (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
      Grassmannian.scalarEnd (g.appTop a)) := by
    rw [← hscalar]
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsIso (Grassmannian.scalarEnd (g.appTop a)) :=
    (isIso_comp_left_iff (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom)
      _).mp inferInstance
  exact isUnit_of_isIso_scalarEnd _

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- An invertible pulled-back coordinate forces the image into its standard chart. -/
theorem range_subset_opensRange_of_isIso_pullback_coordinateHomGlued
    {T : Scheme.{0}} (f : T ⟶ (glueData n).glued) (i : n)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (coordinateHomGlued n i))] :
    Set.range f ⊆ ((glueData n).ι i).opensRange := by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨j, z, hz⟩ := (glueData n).ι_jointly_surjective (f x)
  have hx : x ∈ Set.range (pullback.fst f ((glueData n).ι j)) := by
    rw [IsOpenImmersion.range_pullbackFst]
    exact ⟨z, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
  let g := pullback.snd f ((glueData n).ι j)
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ (glueData n).ι j)).map
      (coordinateHomGlued n i)) := by
    let e : Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ (glueData n).ι j) ≅
        Scheme.Modules.pullback f ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f ((glueData n).ι j)) :=
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (pullback.condition (f := f)
        (g := (glueData n).ι j)).symm) ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (pullback.fst f ((glueData n).ι j)) f).symm
    apply (NatIso.isIso_map_iff e (coordinateHomGlued n i)).mpr
    change IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f ((glueData n).ι j))).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (coordinateHomGlued n i)))
    infer_instance
  have hu := isUnit_appTop_coord_of_isIso_pullback n i j g
  have hpoint : g y ∈ ((glueData n).U j).basicOpen
      ((chartSectionsIso n j).hom (formChart 1 j ⟨X i, X_mem_deg_one n i⟩)) := by
    change y ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ (((glueData n).U j).basicOpen
      ((chartSectionsIso n j).hom (formChart 1 j ⟨X i, X_mem_deg_one n i⟩)))
    rw [Scheme.preimage_basicOpen_top, Scheme.basicOpen_of_isUnit _ hu]
    trivial
  rw [basicOpen_formChart_coord] at hpoint
  have hfg : (basicOpenCover n).fromGlued (f x) = (basicOpenCover n).f j (g y) := by
    rw [← hy]
    change ((pullback.fst f ((glueData n).ι j) ≫ f) ≫
        (basicOpenCover n).fromGlued) y = _
    rw [pullback.condition, Category.assoc, Scheme.Cover.ι_fromGlued]
    rfl
  have hmem : (basicOpenCover n).fromGlued (f x) ∈
      Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{0} ℤ)) (X i) := by
    rw [hfg]
    exact hpoint
  refine ⟨⟨(basicOpenCover n).fromGlued (f x), hmem⟩, ?_⟩
  apply (basicOpenCover n).fromGlued.homeomorph.injective
  change (((glueData n).ι i ≫ (basicOpenCover n).fromGlued)
    ⟨(basicOpenCover n).fromGlued (f x), hmem⟩) = _
  rw [Scheme.Cover.ι_fromGlued]
  rfl

end AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwist
